high_level_description: This image is a black-and-white tribute to Akira Toriyama, the renowned Japanese manga artist best known for creating the Dragon Ball series. The image is framed with a black border, giving it a solemn and respectful tone. At the top of the image, the text "REST IN PEACE" is written in white capital letters, accompanied by a small white dove icon, symbolizing peace and remembrance. Below this, there is a photograph of Akira Toriyama smiling warmly at the camera. He is wearing glasses and a dark jacket, which adds to the personal and heartfelt nature of the tribute.
